notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes: The early access of Octopus Bar is temporary and free to play for now. VRNOVO is working on additional levels/content as well as making it available for the Oculus Rift. Once the full game is complete we will be releasing it in the Full release section, for a small fee.

notes.title: User feedback
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, extremely grateful for all of your feedback. Happy a lot of you are enjoying the game, and wanted to let you know that in this development stage we have only programmed the game specifically for the HTC Vive. We are currently working on a version for the Oculus Rift soon, we thank you for your patience. 

Just one last note, We really appreciate the feedback regarding the beginning of the game to be a bit tricky. We are taking note. But for now, please start the game with your feet on the footprints located on the ground then you can grab the door at the handle and SLIDE it to the right.

Thanks again for your feedback. We hope to improve the game, with the other levels to come soon!

VRNOVO
